title: EntityRecord
description: A single entity record. The specific fields available depend on the entity schema configured in the tenant's Data Service. All records include the following system-managed fields.

Id.description: Unique system-assigned identifier of the record

CreatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was created

CreatedBy.description: Identifier of the user or process that created the record

ModifiedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification

ModifiedBy.description: Identifier of the user or process that last modified the record
